title: 12 Days Kilimanjaro Machame Climb and Serengeti Safari
rank_math_title: Kilimanjaro Climb and Serengeti Safari in 12 Days
rank_math_desc: Kilimanjaro climb and Serengeti safari in 12 days: 7-day Machame route to Uhuru Peak, then the Serengeti and Ngorongoro Crater.
post_content: This Kilimanjaro climb and Serengeti safari combines Africa's highest summit with its most famous wildlife, on the Machame route and in the Serengeti and Ngorongoro Crater.
overview:
This Kilimanjaro climb and Serengeti safari is a 12-day Tanzania adventure. You climb the Machame route over 7 days with an extra acclimatisation night at Karanga Camp, stand on Uhuru Peak (5,895 m), and then spend two nights in the Serengeti and a day in Ngorongoro Crater before flying home from Kilimanjaro International Airport.

It suits fit travellers and groups who want the full Tanzania experience in under two weeks.

Why combine a Kilimanjaro climb and Serengeti safari?

You are already in northern Tanzania, a day's drive from the Serengeti. After a week on the mountain, game drives are the perfect way to recover, and the Ngorongoro Crater offers one of the best chances in Africa to see the Big Five in a single day.

What to expect on the 12 day Kilimanjaro climb and Serengeti safari

Day 1 is arrival in Moshi. Days 2 to 8 follow the Machame route: rainforest, Shira, Lava Tower, Barranco, Karanga, Barafu, summit night and the descent to Mweka Gate. Days 9 and 10 are in the Serengeti, day 11 in Ngorongoro Crater, and day 12 is the drive back for your flight.

When is the best time?

January to mid-March and June to October are best for the climb. The Serengeti is excellent all year; read our Serengeti migration guide and best time to climb Kilimanjaro.

How do I book this climb?

highlights: Uhuru Peak (5,895 m) on the 7-day Machame route
Extra acclimatisation night at Karanga Camp
Full-day game drive in Ngorongoro Crater

faq.q: How fit do I need to be for the Kilimanjaro climb and Serengeti safari?
faq.a: For the Kilimanjaro climb and Serengeti safari you need good hiking fitness: days of 4 to 7 hours and a summit night of 11 to 14 hours. No technical skills are needed. The safari days are relaxed.

faq.q: Why 7 days on the Machame route?
faq.a: The 7-day Machame route adds a night at Karanga Camp, which improves acclimatisation and summit success compared with the 6-day version.

faq.q: When is the best time for this trip?
faq.a: The best time is January to mid-March or June to October. January to February adds the Serengeti calving season in the south, and June to October is the dry season.

faq.q: What lodges are used on safari?
faq.a: You stay in a tented camp in the Serengeti and a lodge on the Ngorongoro Crater rim or nearby, on full board. We confirm the exact properties in your quote.

faq.q: Can a group or company book this trip?
faq.a: Yes. This is a popular trip for clubs, charities and corporate groups. We add guides and vehicles to suit your numbers. Contact us for a group quote.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport
itinerary.content: Transfer to your hotel in Moshi for a briefing and gear check.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Machame Gate to Machame Camp
itinerary.content: Walk 5 to 7 hours through rainforest to Machame Camp (about 2,835 m).

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Machame Camp to Shira Cave Camp
itinerary.content: Climb onto the Shira Plateau, 4 to 6 hours, to Shira Cave Camp (about 3,750 m).

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Shira Cave to Lava Tower and Barranco Camp
itinerary.content: Climb to Lava Tower (about 4,630 m), then descend to Barranco Camp (about 3,960 m).

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Barranco Camp to Karanga Camp
itinerary.content: Scramble up the Barranco Wall and continue to Karanga Camp (about 3,995 m), a short day for acclimatisation.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Karanga Camp to Barafu Camp
itinerary.content: A short climb of 4 to 5 hours to Barafu Camp (about 4,670 m). Early dinner and rest before the summit.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Summit night: Uhuru Peak, then Mweka Camp
itinerary.content: Leave around midnight, reach Stella Point and Uhuru Peak (5,895 m) at dawn, then descend to Mweka Camp (about 3,100 m).

itinerary.label: Day 8
itinerary.title: Mweka Gate to Moshi
itinerary.content: Walk down to Mweka Gate, collect your certificate and return to Moshi to rest.

itinerary.label: Day 9
itinerary.title: Moshi to the Serengeti
itinerary.content: Drive west via the Lake Manyara escarpment and the Ngorongoro highlands into the Serengeti, with a game drive on the way to camp.

itinerary.label: Day 10
itinerary.title: Full day in the Serengeti
itinerary.content: A full day of game drives across the plains, following the herds and big cats.

itinerary.label: Day 11
itinerary.title: Serengeti to Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.content: Morning game drive, then descend into Ngorongoro Crater for a game drive on the crater floor. Overnight near the rim.

itinerary.label: Day 12
itinerary.title: Ngorongoro to Kilimanjaro Airport
itinerary.content: Drive back to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home.
